narr: Beginning on the night of May 29th, a warm front lifted into the vicinity of eastern Kentucky and remained present overhead until being ushered east by a disturbance on the evening of the 30th. Behind this system, a cold front approached from the north and slowly descended southward through the area on the 31st.||Rounds of rain began on the morning of the 30th and continued to pass through the area overnight. Precipitation then pushed east by the morning of the 31st. One to two inches of rain fell across northeastern Kentucky and caused flash flooding in Greenup and Carter Counties on the 30th. Tygarts Creek also rose above bankfull in the Olive Hill area.
ev: Flooding was observed at the Pond Run Tunnel and on Route 693 near Horsley Cemetary Road. An apartment on Valley Drive also flooded.
Stan Branch flooded and a bridge was overrun with water.
lsr: A bridge being overran with water due to flash flooding.
Roadway flooded with fast moving water along Stan Branch.
Tygarts Creek above Olive Hill rose above minor flood stage of 10 ft at 1230 PM and crested at 11.88 ft at 215 PM.
Apartment flooded on the back side of the apartment complex.
